results.title: The world inches toward catastrophic climate events: ‘Bigger shocks are on the way’
results.description: Scientists have long warned that the world will experience more intense extreme weather events like heat waves, storms, floods and droughts as long as we continue to use gas, oil and coal at our current pace. Those fossil fuels release greenhouse gases, which go up into the atmosphere and heat the planet, which scrambles ecosystems and weather patterns. Still, massive climate events, extremes beyond anything we have seen in modern history, have mostly been thought of as fiction, often been the plots of action movies. Today, such extremes of extremes are discussed as a possibility, even an inevitability, that should be taken seriously and prepared for. INVL Technology results for 6 months of 2026
results.description: Equity of the Company and the Company's net asset value as of 30 June 2026 was EUR 66.1 million or EUR 5.52 per share. At the end of 2025, these figures were EUR 64.6 million and EUR 5.4 respectively. Investments of the Company into managed companies amounted to EUR 70.2 million at the end of June 2026 and EUR 54.15 million at the end of June 2025. The net profit of the Company for 6 months of 2026 was EUR 1.51 million, the net profit of the Company for 6 months of 2025 amounted to EUR 0. 766 million. Additional information: INVL Technology, a company that invests in IT businesses, earned an unaudited net profit of EUR 1.51 million in the first half of 2026, a 97% increase from the EUR 0.766 million profit in the same period last year. The company's equity and net asset value (NAV) stood at EUR 66.1 million at the end of June this year, with a NAV per share of EUR 5.52. Both indicators have increased by 2% since the beginning of the year. "The excellent results of the first half-year and the rapid growth in our strategic areas show that the portfolio companies are successfully strengthening their market positions. This creates a foundation for further growth in financial results and has a positive impact on the companies' value," says Kazimieras Tonkūnas, the Managing partner of INVL Technology. INVL Technology, which is seeking to sell its portfolio of companies, is in communication with potential investors. The process is being facilitated by ICON Corporate Finance, a new mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisor selected at the beginning of this year. Performance of portfolio companies The aggregated revenue of INVL Technology's portfolio companies for the January-June 2026 period amounted to EUR 35.9 million, 22% more than in the same period last year (EUR 29.4 million). Gross profit for the comparative period increased by 23% to EUR 12.26 million, up from EUR 10 million a year earlier. Aggregated EBITDA was EUR 3.96 million, a 46% increase compared to the same period last year (EUR 2.72 million). INVL Technology's portfolio includes the cybersecurity firm NRD Cyber Security, the GovTech firm NRD Companies, and the Baltic IT firm Novian. NRD Companies' consolidated revenue for the first half of 2026 reached EUR 6.42 million, an increase of 15% from the same period last year (EUR 5.59 million). The company generated a gross profit of EUR 3 million, up 27% from the corresponding period last year. Operational efficiency improved, with the EBITDA margin increasing from 12% to 17% over the period, and EBITDA itself rising by 57% to EUR 1.07 million, compared to EUR 0.68 million a year ago. This also improved operating cash flow, which reached EUR 1.47 million in the first half of the year. In the January-June period this year, Novian's consolidated revenue was EUR 18.69 million and its gross profit was EUR 4.84 million, representing increases of 49% and 25%, respectively, compared to the first half of last year (revenue of EUR 12.5 million and gross profit of EUR 3.89 million). The Novian group's EBITDA for the comparative period increased by 71% to EUR 1.98 million (compared to EUR 1.16 million in H1 last year). "Within the Novian group, there is rapid growth in deep tech-programming solutions and artificial intelligence technologies for the defence, aviation, and quantum computing sectors. Revenue in this segment grew 2.7-fold in the first half of the year to EUR 3.9 million. The number of clients in this segment is also growing rapidly," says K. Tonkūnas. NRD Cyber Security's revenue in the first half of this year grew by 3% compared to the same period in 2025, reaching EUR 6.2 million (up from EUR 6 million in H1 last year). Gross profit for the comparative period increased by 14% to EUR 2.39 million (from EUR 2.09 million a year ago), and EBITDA grew by 22% to EUR 1.06 million (from EUR 0.87 million a year ago). "NRD Cyber Security's recurring service volumes are growing, and by the end of the year, we plan to nearly double the number of recurring contracts compared to the end of 2025," says K. Tonkūnas. Managed by INVL Asset Management, the leading alternative asset manager in the Baltics, INVL Technology operates as a closed-end investment company. All of the company's investments are to be realised by mid-July 2028 at the latest, with proceeds distributed to shareholders. results.title: Barfresh Re-Engages with Nation's Fourth-Largest School District, Fueled by New In-House Manufacturing Capacity
results.description: Carton Smoothies Added to the Menu as Expanded Arps Dairy Facility Comes Online Florida's Largest School District Adds New Product for the 2026-27 School Year LOS ANGELES, Aug. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Barfresh Food Group Inc. (the "Company” or "Barfresh”) (Nasdaq: BRFH), a provider of frozen, ready-to-blend and ready-to-drink beverages, today announced it has expanded its product offering with the fourth largest school district in the United States, located in Florida, to include carton smoothies on the district’s school menu beginning with the 2026-27 school year. Barfresh had previously served this Florida district, which enrolls more than 300,000 students. For a period, the Company’s ability to fully support the district’s volume was constrained by its reliance on third-party co-manufacturers, whose capacity and supply limitations narrowed the scope of the relationship. Barfresh has since brought a substantial share of its manufacturing in-house at its Arps Dairy facility in Ohio, and that added control over production and supply has allowed the Company to re-engage the district at a larger scale, now including carton smoothies. The expanded relationship extends a recent run of momentum for the Company in the K-12 education channel. In July 2026, Barfresh announced the addition of 50 school districts across Ohio, representing a combined student population of more than 300,000. "Expanding our work with this district to include carton smoothies reflects the strength of the relationship we’ve built with them over time, and it fits the broader momentum we’re seeing in the education channel following our recent expansion across Ohio,” said Riccardo Delle Coste, Chief Executive Officer of Barfresh. "Wins like this validate the sales execution and product portfolio we’ve built, and we expect that momentum to continue as we head into the new school year. Our ability to support wins of this size is underpinned by our expanding manufacturing footprint in Ohio, where our Arps Dairy processing facility now supports approximately 75% of our frozen beverage and food volume. Once complete, our larger, 44,000-square-foot facility in Defiance is expected to be operating at just 15% of capacity, leaving significant room for further expansion in the K-12 channel with both existing and new products, while also driving meaningful efficiencies. As that additional capacity comes online, we expect it to support even more opportunities.” About Barfresh Food Group Barfresh Food Group Inc. (Nasdaq: BRFH) is a developer, manufacturer and distributor of ready-to-blend and ready-to-drink beverages, including smoothies, shakes and frappes, primarily for the education market, foodservice industry and restaurant chains, delivered as fully prepared individual portions or single serving and bulk formats for on-site preparation. For more information, please visit www.barfresh.com.
